title: 第25章 两首歌换角色

第25章 两首歌换角色-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

《仙剑奇侠传三》筹备中不是什么秘密。

从胡哥伤愈归来，唐人就开始准备这部电视剧的前期工作。

说实话，这段时间唐人对老胡真的没话说。

《射雕英雄传》拍到一半，胡哥出车祸。

正常来讲，男主角出车祸，剧组必须要换人，否则谁知道要等到什么时候？

剧组这么一大帮子人吃喝拉撒都要钱，耽误一天多赔一天。

唐人硬生生等了一年。

《射雕英雄传》赔了太多钱，所以唐人才打算启动仙剑三这个大杀器回血。

老蔡没想到他是奔着角色来的。

奔着角色来更简单，只要你签约，什么都好说！！

“你想演什么角色？”

“我之前玩过电子游戏，喜欢徐长卿这个角色。”

“徐长卿嘛.....”

蔡怡农嘴里念念有词：“这事有些难办，这个角色可是男二号，我准备留给袁红的。”

袁红？他自己知道吗？

要不是场合不对，魏沐都想笑。

袁红在唐人可是老倒霉蛋了，从他签约唐人以后签的角色可以看出来，这货根本不受蔡怡农待见。

可能是长得不够帅？魏沐不知道原因。

他的目的很简单，就是出演徐长卿。

男主角景天肯定不用想，那是唐人一哥的角色。

除了景天，戏份最多的就是徐长卿。

至于其他角色，比如魔尊重楼，茂茂还有云霆，这些角色要么不合适，要么不够火。

说白了，仙剑三播出，受益最大的是仙剑三美以及两位男主角。

其他角色没什么用。

比如魔尊重楼，这位男演员后世有什么发展吗？

提起《仙剑三》的时候，有多少人会想到他。

见对方不说话，老蔡微笑说道：“这个角色不好给你，你可以选择其他角色，或者我们单独给你一部剧，男主角怎么样？”

“真的？”

“嗯，前提是你签约才可以。”

糊弄鬼呢？

先不说这个男主角靠不靠谱，就说徐长卿这个角色根本和袁红没有一点关系。

不好给不是因为给了袁红，而是这个角色八成是给港台演员准备的。

唐人在香港起家，2000年后才渐渐转移到内地。

《仙剑三》的导演是李国立，香港人。

It's no secret that "Legend of Sword and Fairy III" is in preparation.

After Hu Ge returned from injury, Tangren began to prepare for the preliminary work of this TV series.

To be honest, people in Tang Dynasty really had nothing to say to Lao Hu during this period.

Halfway through the filming of "The Legend of the Condor Heroes", Brother Hu had a car accident.

Normally, if the male protagonist is in a car accident, the crew must be replaced, otherwise who knows how long it will take?

Such a large group of people in the crew all have to pay for food and drink, and every day of delay will be compensated for every day.

The people of Tang Dynasty waited for a year.

"Legend of the Condor Heroes" lost too much money, so Tang Cai planned to activate the big killer weapon "Sword of Sword Three" to restore health.

Lao Cai didn't expect that he came here for the role.

It’s easier to come for a role, as long as you sign the contract, everything is easy to say!!

"What role do you want to play?"

"I have played video games before and like the character Xu Changqing."

"Xu Changqing..."

Cai Yinong muttered: "This matter is a bit difficult to handle. This role is the second male lead. I plan to leave it to Yuan Hong."

Yuan Hong?Does he know it himself?

If it weren't for the wrong occasion, Wei Mu would have wanted to laugh.

Yuan Hong has always been unlucky in Tang Ren. From the roles he signed after signing with Tang Ren, it can be seen that this guy is not favored by Cai Yinong at all.

Maybe he's not handsome enough?Wei Mu didn't know the reason.

His purpose is simple, to play the role of Xu Changqing.

You don't have to think about the male protagonist Jingtian, he is the role of the first brother of Tang Dynasty.

Apart from Sedum, Xu Changqing plays the most roles.

As for other characters, such as Mo Zhenglou, Maomao and Yunting, these characters are either inappropriate or not popular enough.

To put it bluntly, the ones who benefit the most from the broadcast of Sword and Sword III are the three beauties of Sword and Sword and the two male protagonists.

The other characters are of little use.

For example, in Demon King Lou, will this actor have any development in his future life?

When mentioning "Sword and Sword III", how many people will think of him.

Seeing that the other party was silent, Lao Cai smiled and said: "It's not easy to give you this role. You can choose other roles, or we can give you a drama alone. How about the male lead?"

"Really?"

"Well, the premise is that you sign the contract."

What about fools?

Let’s not talk about whether the male protagonist is reliable or not, let’s just say that the character of Xu Changqing has nothing to do with Yuan Hong.

The reason why it was difficult to give was not because it was given to Yuan Hong, but because this role was probably reserved for actors from Hong Kong and Taiwan.

Tang people started their business in Hong Kong and gradually moved to the mainland after 2000.

The director of "Sword and Sword III" is Li Guoli, a Hong Kong native.
